paper: Four groups (C, CM, H, HM) with n = 12 per group in animals, RNA-seq n = 6 per group (S2.1.p1, S2.7.p1)
data: 18 libraries in three groups (C, H, HM), 6 each; no CM libraries (GSE319603 metadata)
note: The paper's two named contrasts use only C, H and HM. CM vs C (exercise on chow) cannot be tested from this deposit; it is not analysed.

paper: DESeq2 on raw counts; design formula and whether contrasts were pairwise are not stated (S2.7.p1)
data: One joint model over 18 samples with planned contrasts (primary); pairwise two-arm fits (secondary)
note: Both models are run, so the paper's count can be compared with either.

paper: Table 2 lists Mrtfa as a DEG in HM vs H (TAB2)
data: Mrtfa is absent from the Symbol column; the matrix uses Mkl1 (Mrtfa renamed to Mkl1)
note: Ensembl ID is the join key. Mkl1 is the same gene under its current symbol. The gene lookup records this alias.

data: 27 Symbol values are date strings (for example 2026-09-02 00:00:00 for a Sept-family gene, 2026-03-01 00:00:00 for a March-family gene). The original names cannot be recovered with certainty. Ensembl IDs are intact.
